notes: Content Designer: the shape step is grouped by the shapes themselves — Wide, Landscape, Square, Portrait, Tall — instead of one section per portal, since a design belongs to no portal. Each tile names the portals that draw that shape.

Content Designer: the shape tiles are an even grid of framed cards that fills the column; each band is drawn to one scale so the cards in it are comparable, and a band is only as tall as its own tallest card.
The primary panel is called Omen in the Control Panel, matching the name everywhere else.
